notes.title: Village Tale v1.0 Launches July 28th – Big Update & New Features!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hey villagers![/b][/h2][p]The wait is almost over — [i]Village Tale[/i] officially launches on [b]July 28th[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’re rolling out a huge update packed with content and quality-of-life improvements you've been asking for.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Additions: Build Bigger, Live Cozier[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]+10 new buildings[/b] to enrich your town’s economy and charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]+2 adorable new animals[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]+50 new resources[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New decorations[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Gameplay Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Restaurant & Workshop Buildings[/b] (New [i]Service Buildings[/i] mechanic): Serve your villagers meals and tools to boost efficiency[/p][/*][*][p][b]Festival Building[/b]: Throw local festivals to generate extra income and raise morale[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully working Happiness System[/b]: Keep your villagers joyful and productive![/p][/*][*][p][b]Cloud Unlocking[/b]: Expand your land by clearing the clouds and reaching new areas[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]UI & Quality-of-Life Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Statistics UI[/b]: Track your village’s growth and production[/p][/*][*][p][b]Music Player[/b]: Control the game’s relaxing soundtrack anytime[/p][/*][*][p][b]Levels UI[/b]: View and plan your unlockable progress with ease[/p][/*][*][p][b]+4 New Languages[/b]: Enjoy the game in even more languages![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Supporter Pack Bonus[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]2 Exclusive Pets[/b]: A cute little companion for your villagers[/p][/*][/list][p] Whether you're a returning settler or joining us for the first time — there's never been a better time to start your [i]Village Tale[/i].[/p][p]Wishlist now, tell a friend, and get ready to build your dream village on [b]July 28th!
[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447510/Village_Tale/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]- Knight Owl Games 🦉[/p]

notes.title: Village Tale Demo Patch v0.0.9
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Villagers! 👋[/h1]

[b]Demo Patch (v0.0.9)[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced the Marketplace frequency to be a bit slower and generate money in a fixed rate acorss all resources
[*] Fixed getting an extra awaiting customer when saving and loading the game
[*] Fixed infinite haggling bug when saving and loading customers
[*] Fixed building UI getting stuck when going to the menu from game
[*] Fixed moving buildings snap back to their place when going to the menu
[*] Fixed customer haggling notification not disappearing after completing the mini game
[*] Wishlist URLs now open the Steam application, not the browser.
[/list]

Your feedback is invaluable in making A Village Tale the best it can be. Thank you for being part of this journey—we can’t wait to hear your thoughts!

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nW2Tc4ShSf ]Discord Server[/url]!

Thanks for playing and have a nice day.
-Knight Owl Games
